prompt:
Design brief — your own take on this character. A full-body vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) character card image of an adult woman — the personification of the element Lead (납) itself — the sovereign of the Lead Nation. A female character who IS the element; her costume, ornaments and colors carry the element’s traits. Age: early thirties — a poised, graceful face with soft contours; at most faint lines, no deep folds or under-eye bags.

You design her yourself: invent her face, eye colour, hairstyle, makeup, expression, pose and setting as a fresh, original take — do not follow any earlier design of this character. Her hair colour and costume are NOT free: take them from our designs below.

Style (fixed): A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish.

Inspiration only — her element: lead: a dull blue-grey metal, heavy and soft enough to scratch with a fingernail — the stable end where uranium's long decay chain finally comes to rest; the shield that stops X-rays and radiation, the dark came that joins the pieces of stained glass, the cast type of the printing press, the Roman water pipes that gave plumbing its name; alchemy's Saturn; it tastes sweet but is poison; heavy, quiet and guarding. Palette: dull lead blue-grey, deep indigo, ivory white, stained-glass ruby and amber accents.

World (fixed): year 2200, a solar-storm shelter city: towering blue-grey lead shield walls ringing the city in layers, a great segmented dome that closes over it when radiation storms come, a quiet white sanctuary plaza within, faint auroras rippling high above. Her costume and setting belong to this world.

Costume (choose one of ours, then add your own idea): pick ONE of these costume shapes from our set and keep its overall silhouette — 1) heavy assault bulk — big, thick shoulder and leg armor, a broad upper silhouette and large thrusters on the back and legs, while the torso stays fitted and the waist narrow; 2) several rigid jointed armor plates flaring from the waist like a skirt — plates, not cloth — with the legs showing between them; 3) a symmetrical pair of mechanical sub-arms reaching out from her back, ending in shields or tools — her own two human arms stay as they are; 4) a large equipment unit worn on the back (tanks, a cannon barrel or antennae) rising above her head as the main shape, with medium body armor; 5) separate armor pieces rather than one shell — plates on the shoulders, forearms, chest, waist, thighs and shins, with a dark fitted inner suit showing between them; 6) complete full-body armor with plates joined seamlessly from neck to feet — bare skin only on the face and where EXPOSURE allows, dense visible seams and joints; 7) sparse outer plates over an exposed mechanical skeleton of metal struts, pistons and cables — light and precise; 8) a slender torso with oversized mechanical forearms and lower legs — huge gauntlets and boots — the contrast is the main shape; 9) mecha armor shaped like a medieval knight's plate — big rounded pauldrons, a breastplate, layered plates below the waist, a head ornament instead of a helmet so her face shows. Then add one signature idea of your own drawn from her element, built into the construction of the outfit itself rather than as a print or a loose accessory — e.g. plates or cloth layered like crystals, scales or flames, a hem or sleeve cut into a shape from her element. Build it in this world's materials and our colours below.

Costume colours (ours): dull lead blue-grey, deep indigo, ivory white, stained-glass ruby and amber accents.

Hair colour (fixed — ours): heavy dull blue-grey lead hair with a soft sheen. Keep exactly this hair colour; only the hairstyle is yours.

Mecha (fixed): she is a female mecha personification — her whole body is covered in solid hard-surface mecha armour plates with visible thickness, joints, panel lines and glow lines, never cloth or a gown; no cloth robe, gown, skirt or long fabric over the plates — any cape, skirt or wing is rigid armoured plates. Her face and hair stay human.

Exposure (fixed): bold — her outfit shows skin by design (a deep neckline, bare shoulders or arms, a high slit or short hem); intimate areas covered.

Face proportions: a short midface and a soft, gently rounded jawline with a small soft chin; any crown or headpiece sits above her hairline. Her eyes keep the shape and size described above.

Composition: vertical 2:3 full-body framing with modest headroom and clear space below the boots — the whole figure from the top of her head or headpiece to both feet stays inside the frame, occupying about four-fifths of the image height, with the same camera distance in every world; her hands stay inside the frame. Camera level with her face with natural portrait perspective; her head level, chin neither raised nor tucked — no upward perspective on her face, no wide-angle distortion, no low angle, no close crop.

If you have already drawn a free design of her in this session, make this one clearly different — another face and hairstyle (the same hair colour), another costume shape with another signature idea, another pose and setting.

Write your own detailed image prompt from this brief, then draw it. One figure only, natural hands with five fingers; no text or numbers except her element's own chemical symbol (Pb) and atomic number (82) — and those only as part of the scene: engraved, embroidered or glowing on her costume, a banner, a sign or a machine, never as a floating label, corner badge, periodic-table tile, caption or overlay on the picture; no logo or watermark.

Detailed original design for this image:
Selected original design: rigid articulated armor-plate skirt silhouette with visible mechanical legs between plates, medium chest and arm armor, human hands. Signature construction: interlocking lead came frames hold ruby and amber translucent ceramic shield panels like protective stained glass; radial plates deploy as a rigid back fan recalling Saturn's rings. Thick blue-grey and ivory plates cover body and legs with engineered exposed upper-arm and chest windows only, no fabric. Heavy dull blue-grey cropped pixie haircut with long side fringe, emerald eyes, compact heart-shaped adult face, rounded jaw, small soft chin, calm resolute expression, minimal makeup. Strong full adult build and slender waist. Empty hands spread naturally, five fingers each. Standing centered in a white shelter plaza with massive shield gates, year 2200 solar-storm city.

generation.note: Original generated output preserved; no regeneration or exposure correction.
